visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: A Reusable groupBy Instead of Two Special Arrays
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Odd and even numbers are sorted into two separate arrays with an if / else in a loop. Write a groupBy function that works for any key. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The key function says how to group, and groupBy does the collecting for any number of groups. Adding a third category needs no new array variable.
